conventions.deterministic_subset: The default gate (CI) runs only deterministic stages: PDF page routing (plan_pages/score_page), native text extraction (extract_pdf_text) and hybrid assembly (assemble_hybrid_markdown). The vision/OCR half is opt-in via SA_EVAL_LIVE=1 and never runs in the default suite (family test-isolation rules).

metrics.block_structure: difflib similarity over per-line structural signatures (heading / fence / math / table / list / paragraph), blank lines ignored.
metrics.math_fence: fraction of math spans ($...$ and $$...$$) in the expected markdown present verbatim in the extraction.
metrics.numeric_fidelity: fraction of numeric tokens in the expected markdown present in the extraction.

preprocess.conventions: Plan 87 E whiteboard preprocessing: deterministic grayscale -> CLAHE -> deskew -> border crop, applied only when the quality score flags the image. Baseline/after values are measured on the synthetic fixtures below (no user photos in the default suite); the real-scan corpus remains the owner-supplied eval.
